templates.pat: Based on transcriptomics analysis across all major organs and tissue types in the human body, all putative 20162 protein coding genes have been classified with regard to abundance and distribution of transcribed mRNA molecules, including {{1}} proteins showing a significantly elevated level of expression in a particular tissue or a group of related tissues and {{2}} proteins {{3}} organs and tissues. Read more about the different categories of elevated expression {{4}}.
templates.zh: 基于对人体所有主要器官与组织类型的转录组学分析，全部 20162 个假定蛋白编码基因已按转录 mRNA 分子的丰度与分布完成分类：其中 {{1}} 个蛋白在某一组织或一组相关组织中表达显著升高，{{2}} 个蛋白在{{3}}的器官与组织中检出。进一步了解各类升高表达的类别请见{{4}}。

templates.pat: Tissue {{1}} was calculated, and is here shown as piecharts and bar plot, clickable for target lists, for the two datasets respectively. Protein detection (intensity) is displayed at gene-summary pages for more detailed exploration of the data.
templates.zh: 组织{{1}}已计算，并在此分别以饼图和柱状图展示两个数据集的结果，点击图表可查看靶标列表。蛋白质检测（强度）显示于基因摘要页，便于更细致地探索数据。

templates.pat: The UMAP was generated by clustering genes based on expression patterns. The colored areas represent the area in the UMAP where most of the genes of each cluster reside. Click on a cluster or {{1}} to view an interactive UMAP and details about all cluster annotations.
templates.zh: UMAP 由基于表达模式的基因聚类生成。彩色区域表示各聚类中大多数基因在 UMAP 中所处的区域。点击某个聚类或{{1}}，即可查看交互式 UMAP 及所有聚类注释的详情。
